dependencies.name: AdvantageKit
dependencies.purpose: Deterministic log-replay, telemetry isolation, and input autologging
dependencies.rules: All sensor and actuator data must flow through an @AutoLog inputs class. Never instantiate physical hardware objects inside Subsystem.java.

dependencies.name: ChoreoLib
dependencies.purpose: Trajectory execution, auto routine parsing, and path tracking
dependencies.rules: Target Choreo 2027 trajectory schema. Bind paths via modern Commands V2 factories.

dependencies.name: Commands V2
dependencies.rules: Use modern command factories (Commands.run(), Commands.sequence(), Commands.defer()) rather than creating legacy subclassed Command files.

dependencies.name: CTRE-Phoenix (v6)
dependencies.purpose: TalonFX, CANcoder, and Pigeon 2 motor/sensor control
dependencies.rules: Use Phoenix v6 ControlRequests (e.g., VelocityVoltage, DutyCycleOut, PositionVoltage) and StatusSignals. Avoid legacy Phoenix v5 APIs.
